evidence: The paper uses importance "to check the importance of all predictors and...excluded those of low importance in a step-wise manner" to select features, not to interpret effect magnitudes. Figure 8 reports importance visually but conclusions state only which variables "could be estimated," not their ranked strength. Validation relies on held-out R² (>0.85), RMSE, MAE, and slopes across sensitivity analyses, confirming predictive accuracy but not importance-based claims. The main conclusions concern dataset quality and gap-filling effectiveness, with importance playing only an instrumental role in feature selection—a use robust to impurity bias because it tests variable USAGE (non-zero), not magnitude or ranking.
